title: Extending Symmetric Layer-Rainbow Latin Cubes
summary: An $n\times n\times n$ array on $n^2$ symbols is a layer-rainbow Latin cube if every layer contains every symbol exactly once. We call it symmetric if $L_{ij\ell}=L_{j\ell i}=L_{\ell ij}$ for distinct $i,j,\ell$ and $L_{iij}=L_{jji}$, $L_{iji}=L_{jij}$, $L_{ijj}=L_{jii}$ for distinct $i,j$. We determine exactly when a symmetric layer-rainbow Latin cube of order $m$ embeds in one of order $n$, giving a three-dimensional analogue of Cruse's embedding theorem.
